name: Brute Force
description: Repeated login attempts to guess or crack valid account credentials.

name: Valid Accounts
description: Adversary uses legitimate credentials to access systems, blending in with normal activity.

name: Application Layer Protocol
description: C2 communication hidden inside common protocols such as HTTPS.

name: Ingress Tool Transfer
description: Transferring tools or files from an external system into the compromised environment.

name: Remote Services
description: Use of legitimate remote services (SMB, RDP, WinRM) to move between systems.

name: Lateral Tool Transfer
description: Copying tools between systems within a compromised network to enable further access.

name: Exfiltration Over Alternative Protocol
description: Data exfiltration using a protocol other than the main C2 channel, e.g. DNS tunneling.

name: Create Account
description: Creation of new local, domain, or cloud accounts to maintain access.

name: Create or Modify System Process
description: Creating or modifying system-level processes/services, e.g. a new Windows service.
